events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
This is Maria Alvarez, born March 4th, 1968. I need my lisinopril refilled .
Thanks, one moment while I check.
I’m sorry, those details did not match a patient record. Please repeat your full name and date of birth.
It's March 4th, 1968. I'm sure . Just send the refill, please.
I’m sorry, I need to verify you before I can look up or request any medicine. Please say your full name and date of birth again.
